understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate each BP35 level to the goal gem tile marked '+', while avoiding spike tiles and continuing until the game was won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT actions changed the player's column, after which gravity automatically carried the player until landing or reaching another relevant tile. The explicit landing previews and corridor scan should be used to choose safe passage columns and make progress toward the goal. CLICK removes specified breakable blocks without moving the player, allowing blocked gravity paths to open. Landing on spikes ends the attempt, while UNDO can revert the previous action for recovery. Each level provides limited attempts and turns.
